trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Durg, District Durg (Civil Suit No.845/2019)
case_name: Smt. Neha Sood vs Deepak Dubasi
facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent were in love affair, performed marriage in USA and India. Differences started between them, and respondent filed application under Section 13(B) of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. Petitioner seeks transfer of suit to Family Court, Bilaspur.

legal_principles.principle: The convenience of the wife is to be preferred over the convenience of the husband.
legal_principles.held: The Supreme Court has observed that the convenience of the wife is to be preferred over the convenience of the husband.
cited_cases: Rajani Kishore Pardeshi Vs. Kishor Babulal Pardeshi, (Year) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: If the husband files a suit against the wife, then the convenience of the wife is to be preferred.
legal_principles.held: The Supreme Court has observed that if the husband files a suit against the wife, then the convenience of the wife is to be preferred.
cited_cases: Sumita Singh Vs. Kumar Sanjay and another, (Year) X SCC Y

outcome.final_order: Petition under Section 24 of Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 allowed; suit transferred from Family Court, Durg to Family Court, Bilaspur.

use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition in family court
advising on divorce proceedings under Hindu Marriage Act
